title: Air Products to Showcase Industrial Gas Solutions at the 87th Conference on Glass Problems in Toledo, Ohio
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Air Products (NYSE: APD) will highlight new industrial gas supply innovations as well as glass melting and downstream process technologies at...
body_markdown:
*Air Products Foundation to Contribute up to $15,000*
*to the Ceramic & Glass Industry Foundation*


LEHIGH VALLEY, Pa.


, Sept. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Air Products (NYSE:APD ) will highlight new industrial gas supply innovations as well as glass melting and downstream process technologies at the 87th Conference on Glass Problems in Toledo, Ohio, from Sept. 14-17.


Technologies to be showcased by Air Products at the conference include industry-leading oxygen enrichment, oxy-fuel combustion, waste heat recovery, and smart technologies to enable increased glass production, reduced fuel consumption, enhanced glass quality, and reduced emissions.


Air Products will host a combined exhibit/hospitality event from 5 p.m. to 11 p.m. ET on Monday, Sept. 14 and from 7 p.m. to 11 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Sept. 15 in Salon 2 of the Renaissance Toledo Downtown Hotel, where its industry specialists will be available to discuss the challenges glass manufacturers face in their daily operations. For each visitor to its Salon during the event, the Air Products Foundation will donate $100 (up to a total of $15,000) to the Ceramic & Glass Industry Foundation and the Glass Manufacturing Industry Council to help foster innovation by the next generation of ceramic and glass professionals.


At the start of the conference, at Toledo's Glass City Center, the Glass Manufacturing Industry Council will present its Women in Glass Award, sponsored by Air Products. This annual award recognizes women who have demonstrated excellence in leading, motivating, and developing others in the glass industry.


For more information about Air Products' full range of offerings for the glass industry, including decarbonization, gas supply, combustion systems, technology assistance, safety training programs, or consulting services, call 1-800-654-4567 or visit[www.airproducts.com/glass](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771592-1&h=4221415791&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.airproducts.com%2Fglass&a=www.airproducts.com%2Fglass) .


**About Air Products**


Air Products (NYSE:[APD](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771592-1&h=3786094800&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.airproducts.com%2Fstock-information&a=APD) ) is a world-leading industrial gases company in operation for over 85 years focused on serving energy, environmental, and emerging markets and generating a cleaner future. The Company supplies essential industrial gases, related equipment and applications expertise to customers in dozens of industries, including refining, chemicals, metals, electronics, manufacturing, medical and food. As the leading global hydrogen supplier, Air Products develops, engineers, builds, owns and operates some of the world's largest hydrogen projects. Through its sale of equipment businesses, the Company also provides turbomachinery, membrane systems and cryogenic containers globally.


Air Products had fiscal 2025 sales of $12.0 billion from operations in approximately 50 countries.
